The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement of Basic Life Support (BLS) Ambulance – District Health Society, South Sal mara Mankachar 1. Vehicle Technical Specifications The vehicle shall be a Tata Motors Winger Ambulance (BS-VI Phase 2 / RDE), conforming to AIS-12 5 BLS standards, with a 2.2 L diesel engine, approximately 75 kW power, 200 Nm torque, 5-speed manual gearbox, power-assisted steering, 12 V electrical system, standard braking system, air-co nditioning in the driver's cabin and patient compartment, and seating for driver, co-driver and atte ndant. 2. Ambulance Body Fabrication and Fittings The ambulance shall have an insulated, hygienic patient compartment with partition and communi cation window, auto-loading stretcher, three-seater attendant bench with seat belts and additional EMT seat. It shall include a fixed oxygen delivery system, secure oxygen cylinder mounting, locka ble medical cabinet, LED ceiling and examination lights, emergency LED light bar, flashers, siren, public-address system, AC/DC outlets, inverter, external charging socket, IV hooks, two waste bins , anti-skid waterproof washable flooring and adequate air-conditioning. 3. Basic Life Support (BLS) Medical Equipment The ambulance shall be supplied with the following equipment: Sl. Medical Equipment Minimum Requirement Qty. No. 1 Auto-loading Stretcher Adjustable backrest with collapsible whee 1 ls 2 Portable Oxygen Cylinder Pressure regulator and accessories 1 3 Oxygen Flowmeter With humidifier bottle 1 4 Manual Suction Pump Hand-operated 1 5 Adult Resuscitator Adult size with oxygen reservoir 1 6 Paediatric Resuscitator Paediatric size 1 7 Neonatal Resuscitator Neonatal size 1 8 Blood Pressure Apparatus Aneroid type with adult and paediatric cuf 1 fs 9 Stethoscope Adult and paediatric compatible 1 10 Pulse Oximeter Portable digital type 1 11 Glucometer With strips and lancets 1 12 Digital Thermometer Clinical type 1 13 Nebulizer Portable electric type 1

14 Laryngoscope Adult, paediatric and neonatal blades 1 set 15 First-Aid Box Complete emergency first-aid supplies 1 4. Registration of Ambulance The ambulance shall be registered in the name of District Health Society, South Salmara Ma nkachar District, Assam. The successful bidder shall complete all registration formalities and pr ovide the Registration Certificate and statutory documents. 5. Compliance and Delivery The bidder shall ensure compliance with all prescribed specifications and supply the ambulance fu lly fabricated, equipped and ready for operational use, including all specified medical equipment a nd accessories. Any deviation shall require approval of the competent authority. . 3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address DC Office South Salmara Mankachar Hatsingimari HM Road PIN: 783135 . 4. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 5. Generic For hazardous chemical/item, all precautionary measure as per regulation from the point of transportation/ handling/ storage/ safety/ health/ environment to be undertaken/ specified before dispatch. During dispatch, proper symbol for the hazard/ MSDS/ Batch No./ date of manufacturing/ Gross Weight/ Net Weight/ shelf Life etc are to be written/ printed/ pasted on the body of the packing. 6. Generic The seller is required to print logo as per buyer's requirement.
